summary: Backend-only iteration 4 testing for Forge Fitness. Added 16 new pytest cases covering progressive-overload suggestions and the extended settings endpoint, then ran the full suite: 64/64 passed (48 pre-existing regression + 16 new). Progressive overload verified: POST /api/exercises/suggestions requires auth (401 without token); returns {last: null, suggestion: null} for exercises with no logged history; after logging Barbell Bench Press 80kg x10 done, returns last {weight:80, reps:10} and suggestion {weight:82.0, reps:8, note:'weight'} (~+2.5%); after logging Deadlift 100kg x6 done, returns suggestion {weight:100, reps:7, note:'reps'} (keeps weight, +1 rep since reps<10). Configurable settings verified: PUT /api/settings accepts default_rest/rest_autostart/water_goal, persists them, GET /api/auth/me reflects settings.default_rest / settings.rest_autostart / settings.water_goal, and update_settings merges without wiping existing language/units/notifications fields. Route ordering regression confirmed: GET /api/exercises/{id} still resolves a single exercise (POST /api/exercises/suggestions does not shadow it) and GET /api/exercises?muscle_group=chest still works. Core regressions passed: auth register/login/me, POST /api/sessions returns volume/new_prs/xp_earned, GET /api/gamification, GET /api/dashboard, POST/GET /api/diary, /api/foods/search (empty + query), admin content endpoints still 403 for non-admin. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1209 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (auth/settings, foods, exercises+sessions, admin, photos) for maintainability.
SettingsIn uses body.dict() — Pydantic v2 recommends model_dump(); functionally equivalent but a deprecation warning may surface with newer pydantic versions.
exercise_suggestions leaks internal '_score' key only inside the local `best` dict and strips it before returning — fine, but consider a small dataclass/helper for readability.
No cap on names[] length in SuggestIn — a client could send hundreds and trigger 100s of Mongo queries. Consider bounding (e.g. max 50) via validator.
seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh module-scoped user TEST_iter4_{hex}@forge.app / TestPass123! for the new-feature tests; existing suites continue to create their own TEST_user_{hex}@forge.app users per session. All test artefacts prefixed TEST_ so they are trivially identifiable in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/ (test_forge_backend.py, test_admin_content_and_foods.py, test_progressive_and_settings.py). Run non-parallel: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q -o addopts='' . BASE URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Admin creds admin@forge.app / Admin123!. Progressive-overload endpoint POST /api/exercises/suggestions uses body {names: [str]} and returns {name: {last: {weight, reps, date}|null, suggestion: {weight, reps, note}|null}}. Rule: reps>=10 -> +2.5% weight rounded to nearest 0.5, reps=8, note='weight'; reps<10 -> keep weight, reps+1, note='reps'. Settings endpoint PUT /api/settings merges non-None fields (language, units, notifications, default_rest, rest_autostart, water_goal) into user.settings; /api/auth/me returns settings dict.
